reviewer_mode: independent hostile AAA kinetic-chain and pre-engine gate

scope.isolated_question: Whether the promoted Round011 keyframe preserves Nyra identity and frozen industrial equipment while satisfying the original pose/load guide as one violent full-body deceleration event and meeting a hostile private gameplay benchmark.
claims_not_made: 3D, rig, mesh, UV, deformation, collision, animation, LOD, engine, game-ready, or production-ready status
legal originality, exclusivity, copyright clearance, or trademark clearance

checks.contract: blade center of mass upper-right and outside torso
checks.finding: The complete blade occupies a decisive upper-right diagonal and its visible mass sits well outside the torso.
The continuous hilt crosses the lower chest rather than returning to a waist-horizontal guard.
Both arms advance in a similar forward reach; right-scapula protraction/downshift and left-scapula retraction are only moderate, not the guide's violent opposition.
The whole figure has an off-axis diagonal and some pelvic opposition, but the torso itself remains comparatively long and quiet instead of deeply bowed and torsioned.

checks.contract: compressed loaded character-right foot and leg
checks.finding: The forward right leg is unmistakably dominant and planted, but the boot and greave inflate into a giant block whose scale substitutes for convincing ankle, knee, and hip compression.

checks.contract: character-left rear heel airborne with toe skid
checks.finding: The rear heel is conspicuously airborne and the toe-only contact includes a small physical skid mark.

checks.contract: hair, cloth, plate, and conductor lag
checks.finding: Cloth and several straps lag left, but the hair splits into opposed tail forms while plates and conductor remain too arranged and rigid to share one arrest timing.
Lower-body load and blade direction are readable, yet the quiet shoulder girdle and shallow torso deformation prevent the entire figure from resolving as one caught-mass stop.

identity_and_design_drift.finding: Nyra remains recognizable through face, palette, yoke, capacitor, copper route, and heavy-right engineering, but the doubled hair read and exaggerated blade/boot masses materially violate frozen continuity.

private_benchmark_comparison.method: Six relevant private gameplay views were compared in unlabeled, side-randomized, aspect-preserving two-panel sheets with neutral padding and no retouching. Views were chosen to match costume hierarchy, full-body action, equipment loading, role silhouette, arm-torso force transfer, and overhead mass commitment. All temporary extraction and comparison material was deleted after inspection and was never copied into the repository or publication.

comparisons.focus: layered costume hierarchy and material separation
comparisons.finding: At isolated inspection scale, cobalt cloth, ivory protection, blackened metal, copper routing, and the asymmetric heavy leg produce at least comparable material-class legibility.

comparisons.focus: action arc, threat response, and motion timing
comparisons.finding: The benchmark resolves aggressor, target, prior arc, contact risk, and follow-through in one frame; the candidate remains an isolated posed endpoint.
The candidate's equipment is cleanly enumerated, but most plates, conductor sections, and mounts do not visibly compress, tension, or recoil under the claimed impulse.
The complete figure, external upper-right blade mass, airborne rear heel, and heavy right-leg asymmetry make the isolated combat role immediately readable, despite crude block inflation.

comparisons.focus: weapon acceleration and torso-to-arm force transfer
comparisons.finding: The candidate's huge blade implies mass by size, but paired forward-reaching arms and moderate scapular opposition do not transmit acceleration through chest and spine.

comparisons.focus: weapon mass and overhead load commitment
comparisons.finding: The external blade center of mass is clear, but the benchmark shows stronger ribcage compression, shoulder displacement, and whole-body commitment under an overhead load.

scorecard.scale: 0-10 per category; ten categories sum directly to 100

categories.finding: Face, palette, yoke, capacitor, copper route, and heavy-right engineering remain recognizable, but the single asymmetric braid becomes two opposed tail forms and several frozen proportions drift.
Blade center of mass, chest-height hilt, dominant right plant, and rear toe skid are present; extreme scapular opposition and deep torso C-curve are not.
The lower body and weapon establish direction, but the quiet paired shoulder-arm reach interrupts force transfer before it becomes one violent arrested chain.
The figure is broadly coherent, while shoulder mechanics, torso torsion, right ankle compression, and the grossly enlarged front boot remain physically unconvincing.
The full figure, steep blade diagonal, toe-only rear contact, and asymmetric leg engineering read quickly, but blade and boot block masses overpower the person.
Both complete hands close around separated regions of one continuous hilt, yet the extreme blade-to-hilt ratio, leverage, and guard/base scale do not look controllable.
Core equipment routes and palette survive, but doubled hair motion, mostly rigid plates/conductor, and uneven lag timing weaken frozen design and event continuity.
The illustration is polished and material classes separate cleanly, but uniform studio treatment and repeated micro-detail do not reach authored gameplay lighting, context, or surface response.
The receipt supports bounded original concept generation without benchmark input, but the result meets only 2 of 6 private comparisons and supplies no authored gameplay artifact.

categories.category: avoidance of historical, samurai, odachi, and studio-guard relapse
categories.finding: Industrial clamps, copper systems, and the clipped broad blade reduce literal historical coding, but the long wrapped sword and neutral staged presentation retain odachi/studio-guard residue.

engine_and_game_capture_truth.finding: The workspace contains an installed editor and a Unity template/review shell, but no Nyra Round011 integration, gameplay controller architecture, encounter scene, or player build. Running an unrelated review shell could not produce matched gameplay evidence for this 2D keyframe, so no engine run or fabricated capture was performed.

paid3D.finding: Paid 3D remains locked because the composite, category-floor, benchmark, and isolated-event gates all fail.

single_biggest_remaining_gap: The upper-body force chain is not mechanically arrested: both scapulae and arms still advance as a quiet paired reach, so the upper-right blade mass never resolves through a push-pull shoulder girdle into the ribcage-pelvis C-curve as one violent stop.
next_round_prescription_limited_to_singl: Freeze identity, costume, weapon proportions, feet, and framing; re-author only the shoulder-girdle/ribcage force transfer by driving the right scapula down-forward with a tightly folded elbow, pulling the left scapula back-up with a long elbow, and deepening the resulting ribcage-pelvis C-curve until the caught blade mass visibly loads that one upper-body chain.
